name: showcase_water_sphere_preview
_comment: doubled (~44k particles instead of ~354k). Same wall-damping setting, and the same
_comment. This is the tier the internal design notes' own repro used
(labeled there as "下見ティア"), and the tier section 9 measured the fix on.

steps.label: viscosity_coe=0.010 -- same as SHOWCASE_WATER_SPHERE (viscosityCoe is a kinematic viscosity and is not rescaled with the radius)
pressure_coe_scale=20.0 (same as SHOWCASE_WATER_SPHERE, not scaled with radius)
time_step=0.0002 (dt upper bound scales with sqrt(effectLength), not radius -- see the preset's note)

wall damping 0.35: takes the restitution off the wall penalty spring, which on its own has a measured coefficient of restitution of 1.03. Kept because it costs nothing, but it is NOT what fixed this scene -- with the density clamp and viscosity right, particles penetrate the wall by only ~5% of h and zeta changes peak speed by under 1% at this tier (internal design notes section 11.5)
empty at frame 1: degenerate (zero-size) box seeds at most 1 particle at the origin (see showcase_water_sphere.json's note)
Water Sphere container: center (0,0,0) r=0.25 max_penetration=0.04 (2x, matching this tier's 2x effect length)
emitter budget at this spacing (0.010): pi*(R^2 z - z^3/3 + 2R^3/3) / 0.010^3
rebuild: 0 particles, sphere boundary + max-particle budget now active
precondition: starts essentially empty (0 or 1 particle)
Inflow emitter: center (0.04,0,0.15) r=0.075 dir=(0,0,-1) speed=2.45 Blender -> native; rate = pi*0.075^2*2.45/0.010^3
bake 240 frames x 25 substeps = 6000 physics steps (1 frame = 25*2e-4 = 5.00ms physical time), one PLY per frame
change: the sphere has filled -- particle count grew from the empty start
